en.usage:
usage: tagents-knowledge <command>

  index [--dir D] [--db F] [--full]
  search <query…> [--tag T] [--type T] [--kind K] [--limit N] [--json] [--usage-db F] [--verbose]
  show <id[#heading]> [--dir D] [--usage-db F] [--verbose]
  list [--type T] [--kind K] [--tag T] [--json]
  lint [--dir D]
  toc [--dir D] [--check]
  usage [--dir D] [--db F] [--usage-db F] [--since Nd] [--top N] [--type T] [--all] [--candidates] [--min-gets N] [--min-days N] [--json]

exit: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 4 nothing found
en.noDir:
no knowledge directory: set OKB_DIR, pass --dir, or add to {{config}}

{{snippet}}
en.indexErrors: {{count}} file(s) could not be read; run lint
en.notIndexed: index {{db}} is empty — run: tagents-knowledge index
en.issueStem: id "{{id}}" must equal the filename stem "{{stem}}"
en.issueStemSlug: filename stem "{{stem}}" must be a slug: lowercase words joined by single dashes
en.issueTagsList: tags: must be a list of slugs
en.issueTag: tags: "{{tag}}" is not a slug (lowercase words joined by single dashes)
en.issueStatus: status: "{{value}}" must be draft, stable or deprecated
en.issueScope: scope: "{{value}}" must be global or project
en.issueGeneratedShape: generated: must be a mapping with a non-empty `by` and an `at` datetime with an explicit offset
en.issueVerifiedShape: verified: must be a mapping, or a list of mappings, each with a non-empty `by` and an `at` datetime with an explicit offset
en.issueStaleAfter: stale_after: "{{value}}" must be a datetime with an explicit offset, such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00+02:00
en.issueSourcesList: sources: must be a list of mappings
en.issueUpdated: updated: "{{value}}" must be a real date, YYYY-MM-DD
en.issueLegacy: legacy form (`kind`, `updated`): rewrite it in the OKF form with `type` and `generated`
en.issueStale: generated.at {{updated}} is older than the newest commit touching the file ({{commit}})
en.issueIndexOutdated: index.md is out of date: run toc
en.summaryIndex: brings the index in line with the folder; --full rebuilds it from nothing
en.summarySearch: prints one line per hit: id#heading, score and snippet; --type filters by type (--kind is its deprecated alias); deprecated documents come last; each document it returns is recorded as a hit in the usage store (--usage-db F names the file, --verbose says why a read was not recorded)
en.summaryShow: prints the markdown of a document, or of one section of it; the read is recorded as a get in the usage store (--usage-db F names the file, --verbose says why a read was not recorded)
en.summaryList: prints one line per document: id, type, updated, title and tags; --type filters by type (--kind is its deprecated alias); deprecated documents come last
en.summaryLint: checks the claims each document makes about itself
en.summaryToc: writes index.md, the OKF table of contents of the folder, grouped by type; --check writes nothing and exits 1 when index.md is absent or out of date
en.summaryUsage: reports what was read: one line per document with its type, status, gets, hits, the UTC days with a get and the date of the last get, the most read first; --since Nd sets the window (default 30d), --top N the number of lines (default 20), --type T keeps one type, --all adds ids that left the folder, --candidates keeps the documents read at least --min-gets times (default 5) on at least --min-days days (default 3), the ones worth turning into a skill; --usage-db F names the usage store
en.usageColumns: id type status gets hits days last
en.noUsageRows: nothing to report: no document matches
en.badSince: --since must be a positive whole number of days followed by d, such as 30d
en.badCount: --{{flag}} must be a positive whole number
en.usageUnreadable: the usage store {{file}} cannot be read: {{reason}}
en.notRecorded: not recorded in the usage store {{file}}: {{reason}}
en.badIdle: --idle must be a positive number of seconds
en.serveFailed: could not start the shared knowledge server: {{reason}}

ru.usage:
использование: tagents-knowledge <команда>

  index [--dir D] [--db F] [--full]
  search <запрос…> [--tag T] [--type T] [--kind K] [--limit N] [--json]
  show <id[#заголовок]> [--dir D]
  list [--type T] [--kind K] [--tag T] [--json]
  lint [--dir D]
  toc [--dir D] [--check]

коды выхода: 0 ок · 1 ошибка · 2 использование · 4 ничего не найдено
ru.indexed: проиндексировано {{db}}: новых {{added}}, изменённых {{changed}}, без изменений {{unchanged}}, удалено {{removed}}
ru.issueStem: id «{{id}}» должен совпадать с именем файла «{{stem}}»
ru.issueStale: generated.at {{updated}} старее последнего коммита по файлу ({{commit}})
ru.serveFailed: не удалось запустить общий сервер знаний: {{reason}}
